card.name: Prepositions after verbs of speaking or issuing
card.fires_on: Short prepositions like for, from, in or under right after a verb such as sold, reports, issued, speaks, fed or dispensed. The preposition says who speaks, where something comes from, or what it is exchanged for.

modes.label: Speaking for / reporting from
modes.description: for or from after verbs of speaking or reporting, naming the person or place speaking.

modes.description: from after verbs like issue, fed or dispensed, naming the source.

modes.label: Price or yielding
modes.description: for after sold, giving a price, or in after give.
modes.example: By 2011 the same pills sold<< for>> $62 in poor countries.

card.writes: It seems to push toward a noun that names the source, speaker or recipient, rather than words like everybody or whoever.
card.plain: It fires on the small word after a verb like speak, issue or sell that tells who or where something comes from or goes to.
